title: Refresh Reports tab information architecture
summary: Refreshes the WebView Reports tab into an operator triage surface with owner-aware report discovery, richer failure/audit row context, actionable warnings, and Locations support evidence.
reason: Operators needed faster report discovery and clearer separation between report evidence, Diagnostics handoff, and the owner pages where launch, rerun, publish, settings, or manual review decisions belong.
behavior_before: Reports opened with availability metrics and Failures/Audit/Files subtabs. Summary, warnings, paths, locations, and open history were hidden under Files, failure rows had limited context before detail, audit controls sat near audit evidence, and warnings rendered as plain text.
behavior_after: Reports opens with a compact Report Triage band, keeps Failures and Audit distinct, renames the visible Files tab to Locations while preserving its tab key, adds filter chips and owner-aware row evidence, renders warnings as actionable rows, and keeps paths/open history as support evidence.
